book.name: MADIU
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MADIU

content: Karasaras en Sounkamwarak
Ni rahnohte Sises ketiketla sang ni ihmwo, e ahpw ketila ketidiong ni keilen leho, wasa e pahn ketin wia ie sapwellime padahk.
A lapalahn pokon ehu ahpw kapilpene. Ih eri ketidahng pohn pwoht ehu oh ketidiong powe; a pokono mi ni oaroahro.
E ahpw mahseniong irail, kaukauwehwehda soahng tohto ni karasaras. E mahsanih, “Mie sounkamwarak emen me kohieilahng kamwarak eh kisin werentuhke kei.
A ni eh kamwakamwarak, ekei werentuhke ko pwupwudiong pohn kisinial akan en nan mwahto, oh menpihr kei ahpw pihrdo kangala.
A ekei mwerediong nan wasa takain, wasa me pwehl pedeped mi ie. Re wosada mwadang, pwehki pwehlo eh sohte loal.
A ni ketipin eh dakerada kisin werentuhke ko me ahpwtehn wos, re ahpw mwoatoredi oh mengila, pwehki kalewahr sohte lel wasa loal.
Ekei kisin werentuhke ko pwupwudiong nanpwungen dihpw tekatek kei. A dihpw tekatek ko lao keirda, re kasokehla kisin tuhke ko.
Ekei mwerediong nan wasa pwelmwahu, wosada oh keirda oh kihda waren kaparapar: ekei war epwiki, ekei war weneisek, oh ekei war silihsek.”
Sises eri kaimwisekala sapwellime padahk wet, mahsanih, “Eri, kumwail rong, ma mie salengamwail mehn rong wasa!”
Kahrepen Karasaras kan
Tohnpadahk ko eri keiong mpen Sises oh idek reh, “Dahme komw kin ketin doadoahngkihki karasaras ong irail, ni omwi kin mahseniong irail?”
A Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Pwehki e mweimweiong kumwail en ese soahng rir kan en Wehin Koht, a ong irail, soh.
Pwe aramas emen me ahneki mehkot, kalaudpe pil pahn kohieng pwe en ahneki me laudsang. A me sohte ahneki mehkot, a mehkis me mihmi reh pahn kohsang.
Ih met kahrepen ei kin lokaiahkihong irail ni karasaras: pwe re kin kilang, re ahpw sohte kin tehk; re kin rong, re ahpw sohte kin men rong de dehdehki.
Iei me kokohp en Aiseia pweida mehlel rehrail, me ketihtihki,

content.text: kumwail pahn kilikilang, ahpw sohte dehdehki.
Pwe kapehd en aramas pwukat keptakailahr,
Pwe ma soh, re pahn kilangki masarail kan,
re ahpw pahn wekidekiong ie, Koht ahpw ketin mahsanih,

content: “A kumwail, meid pai kumwail! Pwehki masamwail kan kin kilang wasa oh salengamwail kan kin rong wasa.
Kumwail en ese pwe soukohp tohto oh me lelepek tohto anahne kowahlap kilang dahme kumwail kilikilang, re ahpw sohte kak, re pil men rong dahme kumwail rongorong, re ahpw sohte mwahn rong.”
Sises ketin Kawehwehda Karasaras en Sounkamwarako
“Kumwail eri rong oh padahngki wehwehn karasaras en sounkamwarako.

Irail kan me kin rong mahsen duwen Wehin Koht, ahpw sohte kin wehwehki, re rasehng kisin werentuhke me pwupwudiong pohn kisinial akan en nan mwahto. Ngehn suwed ahpw kin kohdo oh adihasang dahme kin kamweremwerdiong nan kapehdirail.
Kisin werentuhke me pwupwudiong nan wasa takaino wehwehki irail kan me kin rong mahseno oh mwadang perenkihda rongorong.
Ahpw e sohte kin tengala rehrail. Ma apwal ehu de kamakam kin lel irail pwehki mahseno, re kin mwadang lohdi.
A me kamweremwerdiong nanpwungen dihpw tekatek ko, wehwehki irail kan me kin rong mahseno, ahpw anahn en sampah kan oh poakepen dipwisou kan kin kasokehla mahseno rehrail, iei me e sohte kin wahki.
A me pwupwudiong nan pwelmwahwo, wehwehki irail kan me kin rong mahseno oh wehwehki mwahu mehlel; e ahpw kin wa rehrail, rehn ekei uwen tohtohn wa epwiki, a rehn ekei weneisek, a rehn ekei silihsek.”
Karasaras en Dihpw Suwed kan
Sises pil mahsanihong irail pil apwoat karasaras: “Wehin Koht rasehng aramas emen me kamwerediong kisin war mwahu kei nan eh mwaht.
Nipwong ehu, nindokon aramas koaros ar memeir, eh imwintihti men ahpw kohla kamwerehdi weren dihpw suwed kei nanpwungen war mwahu ko, oh kohkohlahsang.
War mwahu ko lao wosada oh keirda, oh wa kan pwerla, dihpw suwed ko ahpw pil pwarada.
En ohlo eh ladu ko ahpw pwarodo reh oh patohwanohng, ‘Maing, kaidehn war mwahu kei me komw kamwerediong nan omwi mwahto? A ia duwe, dihpw suwed ko kohsang ia?’
Ih eri sapengkin irail, ‘Imwintihti men me wiahda met.’ A ladu ko ahpw idek reh, ‘Komw soh kupwurki se en kolahng usadahsang dihpw suwed ko?’
A e sapengkin irail, ‘Soh, ieremen; pwe kumwail dehr pil iangahkihsang kisin tuhke mwahu ko, ma kumwail pahn mwatihasang dihpw suwed ko.

Kumwail mweidohng pwe irail koaros, dihpw suwed ko oh kisin tuhke mwahu ko, en keirda lao lel ahnsoun rahk. Eri, ni ahnsowo I nek ndaiong soundolung kan re en usada mahs dihpw kan oh kihpene ni kapakap kei pwe en isihsla; a wahntuhke mwahu kan en kohpene oh nekidala nan imwei imwen nahk.’”
Karasaras en Werentuhke Tikitik

Sises pil mahsanihong irail apwoat karasaras: “Wehin Koht rasehng kisin werentuhke tikitik kis, me keieu tikitik rehn kisin werentuhke koaros. Aramas emen ahpw ale oh kamwerediong nan sapwe. E lao keirda, e ahpw wiahla tuhke laud pwoat nanpwungen kisin tuhke kan koaros. Ni eh wiahla tuhke laud pwoat, menpihr kan ahpw kin pihrdo oh wiahda pasarail nin rah kan.”
Karasaras en Ihs
Sises pil mahsanihong irail karasaras pwoatet: “Wehin Koht rasehng ihs, me lih emen ale oh doalohkihda nesen pilawa ieu, nesen pilawao pwon lao mpwosada.”
Sises kin ketin Doadoahngki Karasaras
Mepwukat koaros Sises kin ketin padahkihong pokono ni karasaras; pwe ihte ni karasaras me e kin mahsanihong irail mehkot, ni eh kin ketin wia sapwellime padahk.
E kin ketin wia met pwe en pweida me soukohpo mahsaniher:

content.text: “I pahn doadoahngki karasaras ni ei pahn kin koasoi ong irail,
I pahn kasalehiong irail soahng rir kan sang ni tepin kawa.”

content: Sises ketin Kawehwehda Karasaras en Dihpw Suwedo
Sises eri ketiketla sang pokono oh ketilong nan ihmw ehu. Sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw keiong mpe oh patohwanohng, “Maing, komw ketin kawehwehiong kiht mahs karasaras en dihpw suwedo ko nan mwahto.”
Sises eri ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Sounkamwarak war mwahwo, iei Nein-Aramas;
mwahto iei sampah; war mwahwo, iei aramas akan me towedahr Wehin Koht; dihpw suwed ko, iei aramas akan me iengen Sehdan;
oh imwintihtio me kamwerehdi weren dihpw suwed ko, iei Tepil. Ahnsoun rahk, iei imwin kawa; oh tohndoadoahk kan, iei tohnleng kan.
Eri, duwen dihpw suwed ar kin oaroahrpene oh isihsla nan kisiniei, e pil pahn duwehte ni imwin kawa:
Nein-Aramas pahn poaronepeseng sapwellime tohnleng kan pwe re en kapokonepene sang nan eh Wehio irail koaros me kin kahrehiong aramas dihp, oh me suwed teikan koaros,
pwe re en keseiraillahng nan uhmw mwehl, wasa re pahn sengiseng ie oh ngihrail kan tehtehrek.
A me lelepek kan pahn lingalingla nan Wehin Samarailo duwehte ketipin. Eri, kumwail rong, ma mie salengamwail mehn rong wasa!”
Karasaras en Pai Kesempwal Rir ehu

“Wehin Koht rasehng pai kesempwal rir ehu, me wie ekiek pahn pwehl nan sahpw ehu. Aramas emen ahpw diarada pahn pwelen sahpwo, e ahpw pwurehng ekihla pahn pwehlo. Ih eri pereperen kohla netikihla mehkoaros me e ahneki oh pwurala pwainda sahpwo.”
Karasaras en Takai Kesempwal ehu
“Pil Wehin Koht rasehng sounnet emen me reperepen takai kesempwalseli.
E lao diarada me ieu me keieu kesempwahlie, e ahpw kohla netkihla eh dipwisou kan koaros, pwe en pwainda takai kesempwalo.”
Karasaras en Uhk
“Pil ehu, Wehin Koht rasehng uhk pwoat me kin sehkpeseng nansed pwe en kehldi soangen mwahmw koaros.
Ni eh diralahr, soused kan ahpw kin wurahdekidahng ni oaroahr oh mwohndi pwe re en pilehng mwomw mwahu kan nan ar pekid kan, a me sakanakan kan kin lekdekla.
Eri, ih duwen me pahn wiawi ni imwin kawa: tohnleng kan pahn pekederpeseng pwe en katohrehsang aramas suwed kan rehn me mwahu kan,
oh kesepwekeiraillahng nan uhmw mwehl, wasa re pahn sengiseng ie oh ngihrail kan tehtehrek.”
Kepwe Kesempwal me Kapw oh me Mering
Sises eri ketin keinemwe rehrail, “Kumwail wehwehki soahng pwukat koaros?” A irail patohwanohng, “Ei Maing, se wehwehki.”

A e ahpw uhd mahsanihong irail, “Eri, met wehwehki me sounpadahk koaros en Kosonnedo me pahn wiahla tohnpadahk nan Wehin Koht, re rasehng kaunen peneinei men me kin kapwarehda sang nan imwe imwen nahk kepwe kapw oh kepwe mering kan.”
Sises ketin Sekeniken pahn mehn Nasaret
Kedekedeo, Sises lao ketin kaimwisekala karasaras pwukat, e ahpw ketiketla sang wasao,

ketiketlahng nan uhdakeo. E ahpw ketin kawehwehda mahsen en Koht nan arail sinakokeo. Irail ahpw pwuriamweikihla, ndinda, “E padahngki sang ia soangen loalokonget? Oh sapwellime manaman akan kohsang ia?
Kaidehkin ine Mery, oh rie kan, Seims, Sosep, Saimon, oh Sudas?
Rie lih kan koaros soh kin mihmi rehtail? Eri, e padahngki sang ia soahng pwukat koaros?”
Irail eri soaikala Sises. A Sises ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail, “Aramas akan kin wauneki soukohp akan wasa koaros likin nan ar kahnimw oh nan ar peneinei.”
Ih eri sohte wiahda manaman tohto wasao, pwehki ar seupwoson.
